design_decisions.b_tree3_is_d1: 0021's fourth floor, B-tree3, is D1 (DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=0)) under another name; fitted twice on the same rung it banks the identical per-example vector twice and the reader's pairwise-distinct clause VOIDs the run. Found while writing the gate's control (the recipe comparison), before the freeze: three floors are refitted, the tree floor is the rung's D1 reading, the order has 37 fits, and the gate keeps a case that banks the tree's vector under a floor's name and expects VOID
design_decisions.caps_never_raised: the iteration caps are part of the sealed recipe; a capped role at rung 8 or 7 is named in the same sentence as the gain and the lead, the gain is read as is (never re-parameterised) and the flags gain_is_a_recipe_reading and lead_at_top_is_a_recipe_comparison say what the reading is
design_decisions.expected_outcome: On the fourth doubling: FOURTH_DOUBLING_RISES if the gain resembles 0024's last two second-decade gains (0.0064, 0.0104), FOURTH_DOUBLING_BELOW_RATE if it resembles the first (0.0043); the paired half-width of a one-doubling model gain over the 1488 scored real chunks was 0.0035 to 0.0036 on 0024's banked vectors, so NOT_RESOLVED needs a gain below about 0.0035 and FALLS a fall of that size. For RISES: the gains grew over 0024's second decade and py_src, the largest family, gets its fourth doubling mostly from new projects, as its second decade did. Against: the fourth doubling's Python and RFC files come from projects other than rungs 5..7's, every reading the record has of content the model did not see is flat (0015, 0018/0019), and the model's iteration count is projected at [177, 248] against its cap of 250, which if reached biases the gain downward. On the lead: NO_SEPARATION at least as likely as MODEL_LEADS - 0024's gap of 0.0039 at rung 7 sat against a paired half-width of 0.0038, the rung-4 reading was NO_SEPARATION, and the second-decade slope difference's interval [-0.00102, 0.00231] includes 0; LINEAR_LEADS needs the gap to reverse by about 0.0077. Either reading on either part is published at the same size in the same places; the verdict string names both.
design_decisions.no_replicate: a second nesting of rung 8 would double the fourth doubling's pool and its fits; the fit-side variance of one doubling is named as what this does not cover and the new shift arm against 0024's is the one between-draw comparison banked
design_decisions.no_slope_is_a_clause: seven of the eight points are banked: with rung 8 equal to rung 7 the eight-rung OLS slope is 0.006237 per doubling, above the bar; it falls below 0.005 only if rung 8 reads below 0.1256, a fall of 0.0148 from rung 7, larger than any move in the record; a clause that cannot fail is decoration (OPERATING_RULES 4), so the two-decade slope is a flag and the fourth doubling alone is the clause
design_decisions.one_doubling_nested_on_0024s_pool: Rung 8 holds rung 7 plus, per family, the next n_f x 8 chunks with rows of the concatenated pool (0024's pool in 0024's order, then 0025's pool positions in order), so every rung holds exactly 2^d times rung 4's plaintexts of every family and rungs 1..7 are 0024's chunk for chunk. One doubling, not more, because a fifth would need another 16 x n_f plaintexts per family (about 350 MB of Python source alone) and a float64 block of about 7.5 GB on a 15 GB machine; and because one doubling is what closes the two-decade span. The fourth doubling's rows are permuted whole by a sealed stream so that M4's last-10 percent validation split is a random tenth; rungs 1..7 keep 0024's order.
design_decisions.reproduction_before_any_new_plaintext: null on the top rung; rung 7 first (three of 0021's floors refitted, then 0024's three roles: the anchor the fourth-doubling gain and the lead read against, so a failed reproduction of it is seen before anything else is spent); rung 4 (0021's block), rungs 1, 2, 3 (0023's), rungs 5 and 6 (0024's) - every reproduction before any new plaintext is fitted; rung 8 (the floors, then the tree, the logistic, the model); then 0024's shift arm (reproduced) and the new one, the model last within each
design_decisions.seed_stability: twenty other bootstrap seeds re-read the two verdict intervals; the counts are flags, quoted beside any reading whose interval bound is within 0.0005 of 0 (0024's rung-7 lead had a 2.5th percentile of 0.0001)

design_decisions.the_clause_is_the_fourth_doubling: rung 8 minus rung 7 for the model on the real-family rows, with the 95 percent paired cluster-bootstrap interval over the scored real chunks (0024's resamples: the same generator construction, seed and draw order): the interval's 97.5th percentile below 0 is FOURTH_DOUBLING_FALLS; else a gain >= 0.005 with the 2.5th percentile above 0 is FOURTH_DOUBLING_RISES; else a 2.5th percentile above 0 is FOURTH_DOUBLING_BELOW_RATE; otherwise FOURTH_DOUBLING_NOT_RESOLVED (never 'flat', never 'equal'). The interval covers the resampling of the 1488 scored real chunks of five files only, not the draw of rung 8's plaintexts nor the fit side. If the model at rung 8 or at rung 7 is at its iteration cap, the reading is still read by the rule as is (the cap is part of the sealed recipe and is never raised), the verdict string is still emitted, every document that states it states '(the model at its iteration cap at rung N)' in the same sentence, and the gain is not quoted as a recipe reading; a BELOW_RATE, NOT_RESOLVED or FALLS with the model at cap is published as such. The bar is 0023's and 0024's 0.005 per doubling restated as a one-doubling gain, a design choice made before any rung-8 number exists: 'the record's rate' in this document always means 0.005 per doubling. 0.005 over one doubling is 192 rows of 38452. Each of the four readings is a legitimate outcome published at the same size; no reading is a pass.
design_decisions.the_floors: 0021's four trivial-baseline recipes (majority class, stratified prior, one thresholded feature, depth-3 tree): B-majority, B-stratified and B-feat1 verbatim, refitted on rung 7 and on rung 8 and scored on the same rows; B-tree3 is D1 (DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=0)), so the tree floor at a rung is the curve's depth3_tree reading there, fitted once (fitted twice it would bank the same vector under two names and the reader's pairwise-distinct clause would VOID the run; found at the pre-freeze gate). 0021's clause - the best floor plus 0.05 - is banked at both rungs as a flag with no 'optimistic' caveat, beside the variant with the standardised logistic among the floors (OPERATING_RULES 4a names logistic regression). Pre-committed sentences: 'clears' reads '0021's margin re-applied at sixteen times 0021's plaintexts, informational, revising nothing of 0021's verdict'; 'does not clear' reads 'at sixteen times 0021's plaintexts the boosted recipe is still within 0.05 of the best rule a person could write out'.
design_decisions.the_lead_rule_is_in_the_verdict_string: the 95 percent paired cluster-bootstrap interval of model minus logistic real-family top-1 at rung 8 (the top rung), over the scored real chunks with the slope bootstrap's own resamples: entirely above 0 is MODEL_LEADS, entirely below 0 is LINEAR_LEADS, otherwise NO_SEPARATION (never 'equal'); the verdict string carries it as a suffix. If the model or the logistic at rung 8 (the top rung) is at its iteration cap, the suffix is still read by the rule, but every document that states it states '(the <role> at its iteration cap at rung 8 (the top rung))' in the same sentence and the lead is not quoted as a recipe comparison, exactly as the difference flag is not. This is not a pass/fail clause: each of the three readings is a legitimate outcome and the verdict string carries whichever the interval gives, beside the gain part. No document quotes the gain part without the lead part.

Its readings, its differences from rungs 4, 7 and 8 and from 0024's shift arm (the between-draw comparison of two draws of other files at the same count, with a paired interval) are banked as flags.

Add a gate control built from the runner's real shape, with r7_floor_majority and r8_floor_majority identical, that must PASS, and keep a mutation that banks a recipe's vector under a floor's name and expects VOID. Update design.floors and the englog so they name this second identical-vector case beside B-tree3.

pre_freeze_instrument_review.method: a four-lens adversarial review of the unfrozen instrument (corpus and partition; runner; reader and gate; design and prose), each finding to be refuted by independent skeptics. The review's session hit its usage limit: the runner and reader-and-gate lenses returned findings, the corpus-and-partition and design-and-prose lenses did not run to completion, and no skeptic ran. The findings below are therefore unrefuted and not yet adjudicated; the two missing lenses must run before the freeze.

why_this_exists: 0024 read SECOND_DECADE_RISES_MODEL_LEADS: over 130 to 8232 real plaintexts the model's second-decade slope was 0.00697 per doubling (interval [0.00571, 0.00824]), the logistic's 0.00638, the tree's -0.0003; at the top rung the model led the logistic by 0.0039 with a paired interval [0.0001, 0.0077], one unit of the fourth decimal above 0; the rung-to-rung model gains over the second decade were [0.0043, 0.0064, 0.0104]. The span was 1.8016 decades, and every 0024 document says 'short of 0003's two-decade scope rule'. This run buys the one doubling that closes that gap - twelve more PyPI archives and 600 more RFCs, pinned, licensed and hashed against every chunk and every kilobyte run of the 0018 files and of 0024's own sources, nested on 0024's pool so that 0024's seven rungs recur chunk for chunk - and asks the only question the eighth point can answer: does the fourth doubling of other files still buy the record's rate, and is the boosted recipe still ahead of a hand-writable rule at sixteen times 0021's plaintexts?
